title: DIF Nuevo Laredo Children's Rights Fair Serves More Than 100 Children With 300 Free Services
excerpt: DIF Nuevo Laredo's Children's Rights Fair served more than 100 children with over 300 free services, including specialist consultations, vaccines and haircuts.
content:
The Sistema DIF Nuevo Laredo, together with the Distrito de Salud para el Bienestar Número V, held the Feria de los Derechos de las Niñas, Niños y Adolescentes on Friday, Nov. 27, 2026, at the DIF Central facilities.

More than 100 children attended, and more than 300 free services were provided.

Most in demand were more than 50 free consultations with neurology and pediatrics specialists, plus vaccinations and children's haircuts. The health district provided vaccination, early detection of warning signs of childhood cancer, and child development evaluation.

Personnel from the Labor Social of the 29th and 16th Motorized Cavalry Regiments of the Mexican Army (SEDENA) joined the fair with haircuts for families.

DIF Nuevo Laredo director general Roberto Viviano Vázquez Macías thanked families and participating institutions, saying it was a pleasure to see families participate and to know these services reach those who need them, and that working as a team brings more benefits to the community.

The fair was held under the commitment of DIF patronato president Claudette Canturosas Villarreal to bring free services and specialized care to the public, especially those who need it most, and in the framework of World Children's Day (Día Mundial de la Infancia), commemorated each Nov. 20.
